description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems—NatSQL (light blue) and an unnamed comparator (dark blue)—across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four difficulty categories in order: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. For each category, two adjacent bars show the respective performance of NatSQL and the comparator. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves 60.21% accuracy while the comparator reaches 63.14%. In Moderate, NatSQL scores 39.64% versus 48.60% for the comparator. In Challenging, NatSQL attains 32.32% compared to 36.11% for the comparator. Across the Total category, NatSQL scores 51.35% and the comparator 56.19%. The chart visually emphasizes that the comparator consistently outperforms NatSQL across all difficulty levels, with the largest gap observed in the Moderate category (8.96 percentage points) and the smallest in Challenging (3.79 percentage points). The bars are not sorted by value but grouped by category, and no additional annotations or visual emphasis (e.g., shading, bolding) are applied beyond the color-coded legend.
